conflict_group: claude-critic-zero-byte-hang-after-pong

1. Reproduce/record failing layer (done in-arc).
2. Claude Critic-spawn hygiene MUST (outFd, no detached+unref, stdin ignore, wait on child, integer fds).
3. Progress gate on Critic spawn (first byte / growth within T_progress); T_timeout backstop; stderr capture.
4. Executable termination boundary (named supervisor, process-tree kill, terminate before reseat, late-post reconcile).
5. Keep evaluateN3LaunchProbe as launchability only (#4432).
6. Keep #5492 adjacent; do not collapse argv class.
7. Containment first; restoration needs later successful pointer-envelope completion.

Reject: timeout+stderr alone; grow evaluateN3LaunchProbe into watchdog; collapse #5492; claim full Claude restoration without post-fix representative completion.

sentences: bug(design-critique,windows): Claude critic seat hangs 0-byte after launch-probe pong-ok (pointer envelope)

Summary On Windows Grok Build parent, Claude-family design-critique critic seats hang with 0-byte stdout logs when launched with the pointer-prompt pattern against a full envelope, even though the same critic argv class returns `pong` at rc 0 for the launch-probe.

Observed on arc #4961 - Launch-probe: `claude -p "…pong…" --permission-mode bypassPermissions` from arc dest → rc0 `pong` - Critic spawn (pointer to dest `.deft-scratch/critic-shared-envelope.md`, stdin closed via Node spawn): three hangs 1.

`--model opus` ~7m, 0-byte log - Codex and Grok seats on the same panel completed and posted - Recovery used: amend-the-spend-down N≥3 → N=2 (comment on #4961) ## Expected After launch-probe pong-ok, Claude critic pointer-prompt should make progress (log growth / tool use / post) within a bounded window, or fail closed with visible stderr.
Actual Process stays alive with CPU, log file stays 0 bytes, no GitHub critic comment.

Environment - Host: Grok Build (Windows) - Parent: grok-4.5 - Dest: `.deft-scratch/worktrees/arc-4961` - Claude: `C:\Users\msada\.local\bin\claude.exe` (subscription / unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) ## Suggested direction Reproduce outside #4961; distinguish hung-OAuth / print-mode buffer / argv pointer failure; add a fail-closed seat timeout + visible stderr capture to the design-critique Claude launch playbook so pong-ok cannot mask envelope hangs.
